description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is mandatory in every modernization plan and provides a safe baseline for subsequent Azure migration work.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a fix requires a major version upgrade, document current version, upgraded version, and breaking-change risk. Verify the project builds and existing tests pass after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Use the existing project runtime/build environment for .NET Framework 4.8 dependency analysis and remediation.
